answer: Make every identity stand on a narrow ledge: it can only earn trust by doing small, publicly checked jobs, one at a time, with no way to borrow another's record. A quiet whisper network of peers shares warnings about copied work, so a fake that repeats itself is spotted fast and cut off. Each verified job adds an ember of standing that only grows with real effort, so an attacker must pay the full cost of slow, visible work for every fake identity, while one honest agent's reputation keeps compounding.
